remainingLocalWork.item: FSR-002 / FSR-010 / FSR-011 first slice — typed statement presentation as genuine PDF, Word and Excel (unapproved draft)
remainingLocalWork.details:

API GET/export routes enforce package scope; export validates CSRF and carries the artifact hash. No migration; existing package artifacts remain unchanged. Observed: Application Release build passed with one NU1900 vulnerability-feed warning; FinancialStatementPresentationTests passed 15/15; the targeted Angular presentation spec passed 4/4; Angular production build passed with the existing commercial-settings stylesheet budget warning; modified Domain test assembly compiled; Markdown, filename, narrative-metric, status JSON and diff checks passed. remainingLocalWork.item: AS-WF-V22 — v2.2 workflow experience PRs D–I (WF-04 to WF-15) and production acceptance
remainingLocalWork.details: WF-01/WF-03 now require an exact proposal/opportunity service-period match before commercial acceptance can advance an engagement; prior-period accepted offers do not carry forward. WF-13 projects candidate, exact checkpoint and persisted Release evidence. WF-14 reports due-task completion/workload with phase rollups and average elapsed hours for append-only procedure-review decisions; Practice analytics also reports bounded PBC client-wait intervals from provider-accepted sends to recorded client actions; it excludes reminders and unconfirmed mail and never presents partial results. WF-14 also records append-only Operational Task creation, initial assignment, assignment/reassignment and completion events in the command transaction, with a grant-scoped 90-day keyset-paged timeline. Existing slices include pinned templates and plan receipts, grant-scoped queues with Waiting for client, Changes required, and Under review views derived from the linked current procedure result, PBC follow-ups/reminders, manager-review rework linkage, and template authoring; see the current-slice handoff. Open: annual engagement preview/creation and fresh year-specific continuance semantics (the existing Partner risk decision remains client-level and generation-bound); additional activity sources and event kinds; review states without operational task links; notification/escalation coverage; domain-evidence dependencies; Kanban/calendar; recurring creation; deadline automation; dedicated task-plan editing; and analytics pagination/performance. No full suite, authenticated activity-browser journey, live-provider or professional acceptance is recorded; overall v2.2 remains PARTIAL. WF-07 additionally has grant-scoped assignment narrowing for named owners and unassigned tasks, with an Angular all/me/unassigned selector and cursor reset; focused UI checks passed but new PostgreSQL assertions await CI.
